segments.reasoning: Establish the nostalgic tone with peaceful moments that make you smile, using longer holds to let the warmth breathe and set emotional foundation
Build anticipation gently through candid laughter and playful energy as music grows, mirroring how childhood memories accelerate
Peak with pure celebration aligned with music's loudest moment at ~21s, using documentary-style cuts to feature multiple joyful memories while maintaining nostalgic intentionality
Resolve with a quiet, intimate moment that lingers, letting the emotion breathe and creating that 'memory you didn't know you missed' feeling
segments.emotional_guidance: Tender reflection on the preciousness of childhood memories

blueprint.text_prompt:
Create a joyful childhood memory video that captures the innocence and happiness of being a kid. Start with warm, peaceful moments that make you smile. Build through candid laughter and playful energy as the music grows, letting the pacing gradually quicken—like how time feels faster as we grow up. Peak with pure celebration and movement, utilizing a fast, dynamic, documentary-style cut rate to feature as many different joyful memories as possible. Then end on a quiet, intimate moment of love that lingers and lets the emotion breathe. Make it feel like a memory you didn’t know you missed.

Text overlay: “Oh, to be this young again.”
blueprint.plan_summary: A 4-segment emotional journey: peaceful establishment (Intro), gentle escalation of joy (Build-up), dynamic celebration of memories (Peak), and quiet resolution (Outro) - all aligned with musical phrasing and the available clip library
blueprint.editing_style: Nostalgic, memory-driven documentary style with intentional rhythm that prioritizes emotional resonance over technical precision
blueprint.emotional_intent: To evoke the bittersweet joy of childhood memories - starting with peaceful warmth, building through playful energy, peaking with celebratory movement, and ending with intimate reflection that lingers like a forgotten memory
blueprint.arc_description: Energy evolves from Low (peaceful establishment) → Medium (playful build) → High (celebratory peak) → Low (intimate resolution), with cut density following the same gentle curve to maintain nostalgic intentionality
blueprint.text_overlay: Oh, to be this young again.
blueprint.narrative_message: The fleeting beauty of childhood joy - from quiet moments of innocence to exuberant play, ending with the tender realization that these memories are precious
